items.title: Roger Kellaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: I think of electronic music I think of Stockhausen and Dofschtetter and Luening and Ussachevsky and all the people from the 60s that I used to listen to

ctx.x: You can see where I’m coming from too.

Those are the two things. I went to the NAMM show a couple of years ago, and I went up to get a demonstration of Sibelius software, which I’d been interested in, it’s a writing program. This guy proceeded to show me how to compose with the computer. As I was watching this I kept saying to him no, no, no, no, no. I’m not interested in this. I will never be interested in this. And he said, “Let me show you how to do this.” And I kept saying my line and he kept — this is what he was going to show me because he’s…
No I’m not familiar with him.
